Dense features and full-batch training; trusted in-process models, no portable persistence or large-scale resource claim.

63 synthetic tests cover visual features, fold isolation, neural loss and dropout, native execution, F1 oracles and no-refit parity; no empirical deployment guarantee.

Trusted in-process states only; no arbitrary forged objects, portable serialization, cross-domain predictive utility or empirical deployment accuracy claim.
Provider approval does not approve the original CDG; its stored execution and served selection require separate qualification.

Inclusive threshold comparison, highest observed threshold among equal computed F1 values. Return threshold and calibration count while retaining the fitted ensemble. Decision selection is not probability calibration or independent accuracy; caller owns meaningful group separation.

Complete out-of-fold predictions and equal mean of retained fold probabilities. No learned image backbone, early stopping, OOF stacking or full-data refit. Dense features and full-batch training; trusted in-process models, no portable persistence or large-scale resource claim.
